shell.dryRunModeHint: The server is in DryRun mode: provisioning never touches GitHub.

login.subtitle: Sign in to the {{platform}} super admin console

clinics.title: Clinics
clinics.subtitle: Every clinic on {{platform}}: its brand, features and repositories.
clinics.empty: No clinics match. Create the first one with “New clinic”.

wizard.title: New clinic
wizard.subtitle: Identity, brand and features. Nothing is created until the last step.
wizard.slugTaken: This slug is already used by another clinic. Go back and choose a different one.
wizard.invalid: Some details are not valid. Go back and check the highlighted fields.

identity.slugHint: Used in repository names. Filled from the English name.

validation.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 40 characters.
validation.appId: Use a reverse-domain id like com.smilecare.app.

brand.logoHint: Optional SVG, up to 100 KB. Without one the template's placeholder logo stays.
brand.logoTooBig: The logo must be smaller than 100 KB.
brand.logoInvalid: Upload a plain SVG file without scripts.
brand.syncHint: This clinic is live. After saving, use “Sync config” to commit the new brand to its repositories.

features.pullNote: Changes are saved immediately and reach the clinic's backend on its next pull (a few minutes).

review.configHint: Exactly what provisioning commits to every repository.
review.reposHint: Private repositories created from the templates.
review.dryRunOn: Provisioning only records what it would do. You can run it for real later from the clinic page.
review.dryRunOff: Repositories will be created on GitHub now.
review.dryRunForced: This server runs in DryRun mode, so provisioning never creates repositories.

provision.intro: Provisioning creates these private repositories from the templates and commits clinic.config.json. Finished steps are skipped on a re-run.

suspend.title: Suspend this clinic?
suspend.message: All of its features switch off for its backend on the next pull. You can activate it again at any time.
suspend.banner: This clinic is suspended: every feature is off for its backend.

activate.title: Activate this clinic?
activate.message: Its feature switches apply again on the next pull.

rotate.title: Rotate the API key?
rotate.message: The current key stops working immediately. The new key is shown once.

key.title: Clinic API key
key.warning: Copy it now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
key.usage: Set these on the clinic backend so it can pull its feature switches from {{platform}}:

clinic.failedBanner: The last provisioning run failed. Open the Jobs tab for the reason, then retry; finished steps are skipped.

repos.empty: No repositories yet. They appear after a real provisioning run.

admins.title: Super admins
admins.subtitle: People who can sign in to this console.
admins.name: Name
admins.deactivateMessage: {{email}} is signed out immediately and can no longer sign in.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE: This feature is coming soon and cannot be turned on yet.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: Another clinic already uses this slug.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: A super admin with this email already exists.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: You cannot deactivate yourself or the last active super admin.
errors.JOB_IN_PROGRESS: A provisioning job is already running for this clinic.
errors.CLINIC_NOT_ACTIVE: The clinic must be active (provisioned and not suspended) for this.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
